def reference.canonical_word (b : Array Std.U8 4#usize) : Result Bool := do

def reference.expand_rows
  (bytes : Slice Std.U8) (out : alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) :
  Result (Option (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8))
  := do
  let b ← core.slice.Slice.is_empty bytes
  if b
  then ok (some out)
  else
    let i := Slice.len bytes
    if i < 16#usize
    then ok none
    else
      let chunk ← reference.read16 bytes
      let a ← reference.expand_chunk chunk
      let s ← lift (Array.to_slice a)
      let out1 ← alloc.vec.Vec.extend_from_slice core.clone.CloneU8 out s
      let s1 ←
        core.slice.index.Slice.index
          (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice Std.U8) bytes
          { start := 16#usize }
      reference.expand_rows s1 out1

/-- [aspis_multiproof_cone::reference::row_shape]:
    Source: 'src/reference.rs', lines 83:0-87:1
    Visibility: public -/
def reference.row_shape
  (row : Std.U8) : Result (Option (Std.U8 × Std.Usize)) := do
  if row >= 27#u8
  then ok none
  else
    if row = 2#u8
    then ok (some (1#u8, 32#usize))
    else
      if row = 14#u8
      then ok (some (3#u8, 32#usize))
      else
        if row >= 15#u8
        then
          if row <= 24#u8
          then ok (some (2#u8, 896#usize))
          else
            if row = 25#u8
            then ok (some (4#u8, 3712#usize))
            else
              if row = 26#u8
              then ok (some (5#u8, 928#usize))
              else ok (some (0#u8, 0#usize))
        else
          if row = 25#u8
          then ok (some (4#u8, 3712#usize))
          else
            if row = 26#u8
            then ok (some (5#u8, 928#usize))
            else ok (some (0#u8, 0#usize))

  (rows : alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8)) :
  Result (Option (alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8)))
  := do
  if row >= 27#u8
  then
    let b ← core.slice.Slice.is_empty bytes

    then ok (some rows)
    else ok none
  else

    | none => ok none

              (Array.make 4#usize [ i3, i4, i5, i6 ]) a

/-- [aspis_multiproof_cone::parser_reference::parse]:
    Source: 'src/parser_reference.rs', lines 39:0-42:1
    Visibility: public -/
def parser_reference.parse
  (bytes : Slice Std.U8) :
  Result (Option (alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8)))
  := do
  let b ← parser_reference.header bytes
  if b
  then
    let b1 ← parser_reference.scan bytes
    if b1
    then
      let s ←
        core.slice.index.Slice.index
          (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8) bytes
          { start := 48#usize, «end» := 7031#usize }
      parser_reference.semantic_rows 0#u8 s (alloc.vec.Vec.new (alloc.vec.Vec
        Std.U8))
    else ok none
  else ok none
